text:
The deed creates a fee simple subject to an executory limitation in the friend, with a shifting executory interest in the sister’s children who reach age 25 if the lot is ever used for church purposes. Because the sister’s children are not yet ascertainable and the condition has not occurred, the friend holds present title, and the future interest is contingent and subject to the Rule Against Perpetuities. The deceased son’s interest failed, and the daughter may qualify only if she reaches 25 and the church-use condition occurs within the perpetuities period.
CONFIDENCE: 82
